title: Pointwise assembly of constant-target mapping-space pullback squares
statement:
Use quasicategories, small simplicial sets, coherent functor categories, coherent transformations, constant diagrams $\Delta_K$ and right-pinched mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and the path-space homotopy pullback squares of [def-coef-infinity-relative-cone]. Let $r:\mathcal X\to\mathcal Y$ be a functor of quasicategories, let $B$ and $K$ be small simplicial sets, either of which may be empty, let $a:B\to\mathcal X$ and $f:B\times K\to\mathcal X$ be coherent diagrams, let $\alpha:f\to a\circ\mathrm{pr}_B$ be a coherent transformation of diagrams $B\times K\to\mathcal X$, and let $w$ be a vertex of $\mathcal X$. For a vertex $b$ of $B$ write $f_b=f|_{\{b\}\times K}$ and $\alpha_b:f_b\to\Delta_K a(b)$ for the restricted cocone. Suppose that for every vertex $b$ of $B$ the square
$$\begin{array}{ccc}\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal X}(a(b),w)&\longrightarrow&\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(K,\mathcal X)}(f_b,\Delta_Kw)\\ \downarrow&&\downarrow\\ \operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal Y}(ra(b),rw)&\longrightarrow&\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(K,\mathcal Y)}(rf_b,\Delta_K rw)\end{array}$$
whose horizontal maps are composition with $\alpha_b$ and $r\alpha_b$ and whose vertical maps are induced by $r$, with its canonical commutation homotopy, is a homotopy pullback. Then the square
$$\begin{array}{ccc}\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(B,\mathcal X)}(a,\Delta_Bw)&\longrightarrow&\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(B\times K,\mathcal X)}(f,\Delta_{B\times K}w)\\ \downarrow&&\downarrow\\ \operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(B,\mathcal Y)}(ra,\Delta_Brw)&\longrightarrow&\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(B\times K,\mathcal Y)}(rf,\Delta_{B\times K}rw)\end{array}$$
whose horizontal maps are composition with $\alpha$ and $r\alpha$ (after applying $\mathrm{pr}_B^*$) and whose vertical maps are induced by $r$, is a homotopy pullback. If $B$ is empty all four corners are contractible; if $K$ is empty the right-hand corners are contractible and the hypothesis and conclusion say that $r$ induces equivalences on the left-hand columns. No colimit existence in $\mathcal X$ or $\mathcal Y$ and no fibration condition on $r$ is assumed.

proof.text: First identify the path-space notion with a limiting cospan in the infinity category $\mathcal S$ of spaces. For Kan complexes $U\to Z\leftarrow V$, the Cartesian simplicial Kan model structure is combinatorial and simplicial by [lem-coef-simplicial-presheaf-projective-model], and all its objects are cofibrant (its cofibrations are monomorphisms, as specified in [lem-coef-simplicial-model-coherent-diagrams]). Its simplicial model axiom applied to $\partial\Delta^1\hookrightarrow\Delta^1$ and $Z\to *$ makes $Z^{\Delta^1}\to Z\times Z$ a fibration. The constant-path map $Z\to Z^{\Delta^1}$ is a weak equivalence: it is the map into the mapping-path replacement of $\mathrm{id}_Z$ in [lem-cbc-kan-fibration-fiber-criterion]. Thus $Z\to Z^{\Delta^1}\to Z\times Z$ is a path object. The final clause of [lem-coef-simplicial-model-coherent-diagrams] now states that $U\times_{Z,\mathrm{ev}_0}Z^{\Delta^1}\times_{\mathrm{ev}_1,Z}V$ with its two projections and path represents the limit of the cospan in $\mathcal S$. Consequently the comparison specified in [def-coef-infinity-relative-cone] is an equivalence precisely when the square, with that commutation homotopy, is a limiting cospan cone. This applies both to the assumed pointwise squares and to the square to be proved.

proof.text: Here is the needed constant-target mapping calculation, with its comparison map. Let $H:B\to\mathcal D$ be any coherent diagram in a quasicategory and let $t\in\mathcal D$. Pull the target-fixed arrow right fibration $\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,\mathcal D)\times_{\mathrm{ev}_1,\mathcal D}\{t\}\to\mathcal D$ back along $H$, obtaining $E_{H,t}\to B$. By [lem-coef-space-transport-classification] it classifies $F_{H,t}:B^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal S$ with $F_{H,t}(b)\simeq\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal D}(H(b),t)$; edge transport is precomposition. Put $\mathcal P=\operatorname{Fun}(B^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal S)$ and $\mathbf1=\Delta_{B^{\mathrm{op}}}*$. The classification's mapping-space formula, applied from the identity right fibration $B\to B$ to $E_{H,t}\to B$, gives $\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal P}(\mathbf1,F_{H,t})\simeq\operatorname{Fun}_{/B}(B,E_{H,t})$. An $n$-simplex of this section space is exactly a map $B\times\Delta^n\times\Delta^1\to\mathcal D$ equal to $H\circ\mathrm{pr}_B$ at endpoint $0$ and constantly $t$ at endpoint $1$. Currying identifies it degree by degree with the arrow mapping space $U_{\operatorname{Fun}(B,\mathcal D)}(H,\Delta_Bt)$. The functor category is a quasicategory by [lem-cbc-enhanced-functor-cone-calculus], so the natural right-pinch equivalence of [lem-coef-infinity-pinch-comparison] identifies this with $\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(B,\mathcal D)}(H,\Delta_Bt)$. These comparisons retain all simplices: none asserts equality with a strict degreewise limit of the vertex mapping spaces.

proof.text: Transpose $f$ to $\widehat f:B\to\operatorname{Fun}(K,\mathcal X)$ using the simplicial exponential identity, and transpose $\alpha$ to $\widehat\alpha:\widehat f\to\Delta_K\circ a$. Form in $\mathcal P$ the four diagrams $F_0=F_{a,w}$, $F_1=F_{\widehat f,\Delta_Kw}$, $G_0=F_{ra,rw}$, and $G_1=F_{r_K\widehat f,\Delta_Krw}$, where $r_K$ is postcomposition by $r$. The upper map $F_0\to F_1$ sends a component $u:a(b)\to w$ to $(\Delta_Ku)\circ\alpha_b$; the lower map sends $v:ra(b)\to rw$ to $(\Delta_Kv)\circ r\alpha_b$. The vertical maps are induced by $r$ and $r_K$. The coherent mapping bifunctor, its precomposition rule, and the composition and pullback compatibility in [lem-coef-space-transport-classification] give this square as a coherent square of $B^{\mathrm{op}}$-diagrams, with the canonical commutation homotopy inherited from $r$ and $\alpha$. Naturality of the pinch map under every simplicial functor identifies the maps obtained by applying $\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal P}(\mathbf1,-)$ with the maps in the requested global square. In particular, currying identifies $\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(B,\operatorname{Fun}(K,\mathcal X))}(\widehat f,\Delta_B\Delta_Kw)$ with $\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(B\times K,\mathcal X)}(f,\Delta_{B\times K}w)$: in every simplicial degree this just reassociates the factors $B,K,\Delta^n$. Precomposition with $\widehat\alpha$ becomes precomposition with $\alpha$ after $\mathrm{pr}_B^*$, including the commutation homotopy; the same explicit factor reassociation identifies the lower-right corner and lower horizontal map.

source.place: Theorem 2.2.1.2 and Proposition 4.2.4.4, transport and coherent diagram comparison; Kerodon Proposition 4.6.5.10 (01L5), natural right-pinch map

proof.text: At every vertex $b$, the square $(F_0(b),F_1(b),G_0(b),G_1(b))$ is precisely the assumed square, with its specified homotopy. Step 1 therefore makes it a limiting cospan cone in $\mathcal S$. The pointwise-limit clause of [lem-coef-infinity-yoneda-presheaf-limits], applied to the small simplicial set $B^{\mathrm{op}}$, makes the square of Step 3 a pullback square in $\mathcal P$: explicitly $F_0\simeq F_1\times_{G_1}G_0$, with its given cone. The same node states that covariant representable mapping-space functors preserve all existing small limits. Apply that clause in $\mathcal P$ to the representable $\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal P}(\mathbf1,-)$. Its image square is a pullback in spaces. Step 3 identifies that square and its cone with the requested global square. Step 1 identifies its limit with the path pullback of [def-coef-infinity-relative-cone]; the induced comparison has coordinates the two global legs and their canonical commutation path. It is an equivalence, which is exactly the claimed homotopy-pullback assertion. No limit or colimit in $\mathcal X$ or $\mathcal Y$ was used, and $r$ was never required to be a fibration. All space-valued diagrams and mapping spaces can be placed in one enlarged universe.

proof.text: If $B=\varnothing$, both $B$ and $B\times K$ are empty, and the internal-functor formula in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones] gives the terminal simplicial set in every functor category appearing in the four corners. Its right-pinched mapping space has exactly one simplex in every degree. If $K=\varnothing$, $B\times K=\varnothing$, so the two right-hand corners are terminal spaces. The path-pullback formula in [def-coef-infinity-relative-cone] then reads $*\times_* *^{\Delta^1}\times_* C\cong C$. Thus each pointwise hypothesis is exactly an equivalence on its left column, and the already proved conclusion is exactly the equivalence on the global left column. This also covers $B=K=\varnothing$.

lean.statement: theorem pointwise_constant_target_square_assembly {X Y B K : SSet.{u}} [Quasicategory X] [Quasicategory Y] (r : X ⟶ Y) (a : B ⟶ X) (f : B ⊗ K ⟶ X) (α : SSet.Homotopy f (fst B K ≫ a)) (w : X _⦋0⦌) : ((∀ b : B _⦋0⦌, ConstantTargetRestrictionSquare r (constantTargetCylinderBase (stdSimplex.isTerminalObj₀.from K)) (constantTargetCylinderVertex b ≫ constantTargetCylinderDiagram (fst B K) a f α) w) → ConstantTargetRestrictionSquare r (constantTargetCylinderBase (fst B K)) (constantTargetCylinderDiagram (fst B K) a f α) w) ∧ (IsEmpty (B _⦋0⦌) → IsContractible (mappingSpace ((ihom B).obj X) (diagramVertex a) ((constantDiagrams B X).app _ w)) ∧ IsContractible (mappingSpace ((ihom (B ⊗ K)).obj X) (diagramVertex f) ((constantDiagrams (B ⊗ K) X).app _ w)) ∧ IsContractible (mappingSpace ((ihom B).obj Y) (diagramVertex (a ≫ r)) ((constantDiagrams B Y).app _ (r.app _ w))) ∧ IsContractible (mappingSpace ((ihom (B ⊗ K)).obj Y) (diagramVertex (f ≫ r)) ((constantDiagrams (B ⊗ K) Y).app _ (r.app _ w)))) ∧ (IsEmpty (K _⦋0⦌) → IsContractible (mappingSpace ((ihom (B ⊗ K)).obj X) (diagramVertex f) ((constantDiagrams (B ⊗ K) X).app _ w)) ∧ IsContractible (mappingSpace ((ihom (B ⊗ K)).obj Y) (diagramVertex (f ≫ r)) ((constantDiagrams (B ⊗ K) Y).app _ (r.app _ w))) ∧ ((∀ b : B _⦋0⦌, ConstantTargetRestrictionSquare r (constantTargetCylinderBase (stdSimplex.isTerminalObj₀.from K)) (constantTargetCylinderVertex b ≫ constantTargetCylinderDiagram (fst B K) a f α) w) ↔ ∀ b : B _⦋0⦌, IsWeakHomotopyEquivalence (mappingSpaceMap r (a.app _ b) w)) ∧ (ConstantTargetRestrictionSquare r (constantTargetCylinderBase (fst B K)) (constantTargetCylinderDiagram (fst B K) a f α) w ↔ IsWeakHomotopyEquivalence (mappingSpaceMap ((ihom B).map r) (diagramVertex a) ((constantDiagrams B X).app _ w))))
